Script.name: DG Updater
Script.script:
-- DG Updater :: the dgupdate command. -- Pulls the latest DG Control package from GitHub and installs it, and (optionally) refreshes -- your shared highlights file from a private repo. Nothing runs automatically: you type dgupdate. -- dgupdate update only if GitHub has a different version than the one installed -- dgupdate force reinstall the package even if the version matches
dg = dg or {} dg.upd = dg.upd or {} local U = dg.upd
U.owner = "macdsj" U.codeRepo = "dgate-control" -- public: the control package U.hlRepo = "dgate-highlights" -- private (optional): dg_highlights.lua, needs dg_token.txt U.branch = "main" U.version = "1.3" -- this updater's own version (UPDATER_VERSION in the repo)
local function say(m) decho("\n<255,255,85>[dgupdate]<reset> " .. m .. "\n") end local function warn(m) decho("\n<255,85,85>[dgupdate]<reset> " .. m .. "\n") end local function trim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
-- the per-computer folder (same one the highlights stub reads from) function U.dir() local home = (os.getenv("USERPROFILE") or os.getenv("HOME") or "."):gsub("\\", "/") -- same order as the highlights stub: the user folder on the C drive first, then the old D folder local candidates = { home .. "/dg-control", "D:/Documents/dglogs/Claude/dg-shared" } for _, d in ipairs(candidates) do local f = io.open(d .. "/dg_highlights.lua", "r") if f then f:close(); return d end end for _, d in ipairs(candidates) do if lfs.attributes(d, "mode") == "directory" then return d end end lfs.mkdir(candidates[1]) return candidates[1] end
local function rawUrl(repo, file) return string.format("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/%s/%s?cb=%d", U.owner, repo, U.branch, file, os.time()) end
-- one small fetch helper: get(url, headers, function(ok, body) ... end) U.pending = U.pending or {} local function get(url, headers, cb) U.pending[url] = cb getHTTP(url, headers or {}) end
-- GitHub's raw file host can hand back an old copy for up to ~5 minutes after a push (it can ignore the ?cb=). -- The API copy is only about a minute behind, so ask it first and fall back to the raw host. local function apiUrl(repo, file) return string.format("https://api.github.com/repos/%s/%s/contents/%s?ref=%s&t=%d", U.owner, repo, file, U.branch, os.time()) end local function isVer(b) return tostring(b):match("^%s*%d[%d%.]*%s*$") ~= nil end local function isPkg(b) return tostring(b):find("<MudletPackage", 1, true) ~= nil end local function fetchRaw(repo, file, valid, cb) get(apiUrl(repo, file), { Accept = "application/vnd.github.raw" }, function(ok, body) if ok and valid(body) then cb(true, body); return end get(rawUrl(repo, file), nil, cb) end) end
local function finish(a, b, ok) local url = U.pending[b] and b or (U.pending[a] and a) if not url then return end local cb = U.pending[url]; U.pending[url] = nil cb(ok, ok and b or a) end
if U.hDone then killAnonymousEventHandler(U.hDone) end if U.hErr then killAnonymousEventHandler(U.hErr) end -- sysGetHttpDone(event, url, body) sysGetHttpError(event, message, url) U.hDone = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpDone", function(_, url, body) local cb = U.pending[url]; if not cb then return end U.pending[url] = nil; cb(true, body) end) U.hErr = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpError", function(_, msg, url) local key = U.pending[url] and url or (U.pending[msg] and msg) if not key then return end local cb = U.pending[key]; U.pending[key] = nil; cb(false, msg) end)
local function writeFile(path, text) local f, err = io.open(path, "wb") if not f then return false, err end f:write(text); f:close() return true end
function U.highlights(dir) local tf = io.open(dir .. "/dg_token.txt", "r") if not tf then say("no dg_token.txt in " .. dir .. ": leaving your local highlights file as it is."); return end local token = trim(tf:read("*l")); tf:close() if token == "" then say("dg_token.txt is empty: leaving your local highlights file as it is."); return end get(rawUrl(U.hlRepo, "dg_highlights.lua"), { Authorization = "token " .. token }, function(ok, body) if not ok then warn("could not fetch highlights (" .. tostring(body) .. "): keeping your local file."); return end if not tostring(body):find("dg.ctlData.names", 1, true) then warn("the highlights download did not look right: keeping your local file."); return end local wrote, err = writeFile(dir .. "/dg_highlights.lua", body) if not wrote then warn("could not save highlights: " .. tostring(err)); return end if dg.loadSharedHighlights and dg.loadSharedHighlights() and dg.ctl and dg.ctl.initSoon then dg.ctl.initSoon() end say("highlights updated.") end) end
local function isInstalled(name) for _, p in ipairs(getPackages() or {}) do if p == name then return true end end return false end
-- the updater updates itself first, then asks you to run dgupdate again local function updateSelf(dir, cb) fetchRaw(U.codeRepo, "UPDATER_VERSION", isVer, function(ok, body) local remote = ok and tostring(body):match("%d[%d%.]*") if not remote or remote == U.version then cb(); return end say("updating the updater itself: " .. U.version .. " -> " .. remote) fetchRaw(U.codeRepo, "dgate_updater.xml", isPkg, function(ok2, xml) if not ok2 or not tostring(xml):find("<MudletPackage", 1, true) then warn("the updater download failed; carrying on with the current one."); cb(); return end local path = dir .. "/dgate_updater.xml" if not writeFile(path, xml) then warn("could not save the new updater; carrying on."); cb(); return end if isInstalled("dgate_updater") then uninstallPackage("dgate_updater") end tempTimer(1, function() installPackage(path) cecho("\n") decho("<255,255,85>[dgupdate]<reset> updater replaced. Type dgupdate again to update the control package.\n") end) end) end) end
function U.update(force) local dir = U.dir() say("checking " .. U.owner .. "/" .. U.codeRepo .. " ...") updateSelf(dir, function() U.updateControl(dir, force) end) end
function U.updateControl(dir, force) fetchRaw(U.codeRepo, "VERSION", isVer, function(ok, body) if not ok then warn("could not reach GitHub (" .. tostring(body) .. "). Nothing was changed."); return end local remote = tostring(body):match("%d[%d%.]*") local mine = dg.ctl and dg.ctl.version if remote and remote == mine and not force then say("control package is already current (" .. mine .. ").") U.highlights(dir) return end local function older(a, b) -- is version a older than b? ("0.39" < "0.40") local pa, pb = {}, {} for n in tostring(a):gmatch("%d+") do pa[#pa + 1] = tonumber(n) end for n in tostring(b):gmatch("%d+") do pb[#pb + 1] = tonumber(n) end for k = 1, math.max(#pa, #pb) do local x, y = pa[k] or 0, pb[k] or 0 if x ~= y then return x < y end end return false end if remote and mine and older(remote, mine) and not force then say("GitHub shows " .. remote .. " but you have " .. mine .. " -- GitHub's file cache can lag a few minutes after an update. Try again in a few minutes.") return end say("updating the control package: " .. tostring(mine) .. " -> " .. tostring(remote)) fetchRaw(U.codeRepo, "dgate_control.xml", isPkg, function(ok2, xml) if not ok2 or not tostring(xml):find("<MudletPackage", 1, true) then warn("the package download failed or was not a package. Nothing was changed."); return end local path = dir .. "/dgate_control.xml" local wrote, err = writeFile(path, xml) if not wrote then warn("could not save the package: " .. tostring(err)); return end if isInstalled("dgate_control") then uninstallPackage("dgate_control") end tempTimer(1, function() installPackage(path) say("installed. Look for the 'DG Control ... loaded' line.") U.highlights(dir) end) end) end) end
